description:
Post an agent-authored reply to an existing comment thread. Use
    comment_id from list_comments (threads[].id), not the document ID, and
    supply nonblank text up to 1,000 characters after trimming. The thread
    must be writable and comments must be enabled. Replying reopens a
    resolved thread, may notify the signer, and returns the new reply ID.
    Use resolve_comment to change resolution without posting a message.
    Requires envelopes:send access.
name: reply_comment
title: Reply to Comment
